measurement.title: Road edit zoning candidates and 64-unit view chunks: frozen equivalence and 30000/50000 native pairs
measurement.runtime: Native Unity Development Mono; ordinary paired runs without fine/raw; separate attribution/raw repeats; same-runtime .NET10 x64 state replay and bounded 50000 authoring
measurement.scenario: Existing regenerated30000 tick4800: 30000 people/7806 buildings/841 roads/5230 active cars. Two legitimate margin-road setup commands and 12-unit/9-point edit strokes. Separate newly authored 50005-person/13171-active-car end save, inputs inventoried.
measurement.method: See Report.txt. 30000 ordinary A1/B1/B2/A2 and final pair, 50000 bounded single ordinary pair. Scope, frame, fine counters, raw GC, ordered cell oracle, complete city states and exact images are separate evidence. Product code matched 3a3ca6e; captures before commit preserve actual HEAD/dirty plus assembly and compiled source hashes. Frozen product zoning/views reference 8273ffa.
limitations: Programmatic real construction/Update chain, no physical mouse acceptance or global FPS/3x claim.
Busy-input widen/delete were rejected by unchanged traffic safety; successful occupied/project widening/deletion/reverse checks are separate production-growth fixtures.
Small native sample count, short legal margin strokes, single 50000 pair; no universal complexity/performance bound.
Frame labels in early ABBA rejected branch included validation serialization; rejected performance marked unknown, later fixed protocol captured final pair separately.
Native thread allocation counter unsupported (-1); GC bytes from separate operation raw capture, not uninstrumented timings. Parent scopes include children.
Some global light iteration remains; worst-case dependency propagation can reach all roads. Caches increase retained memory.
Prototype 4.25GB raw export failed at memory limit; retained and inventoried, not a successful export.
50000 original local file missing after migration; regenerated via existing declared seeded mature fixture under 600s/8GiB watchdog, not naturally grown city or economic-health proof.

local_inventory.scope: All formal raw captures plus failed full fine raw, common inputs, representative final/in-flight saves and compiled assemblies for this task. Intermediate failures remain under the same local Temp tree.
